summary: M2 CORE stress test — 5 agents concurrent on same agency (Nicastro Immobiliare). Seeded 4 agents directly in MongoDB (with correct bcrypt hash). Ran 5 concurrent stress scenarios via ThreadPoolExecutor: parallel login, 25 concurrent CREATE properties, 50 concurrent READ, 5 concurrent PATCH on same property, 15 concurrent matching, tenant isolation. All FUNCTIONAL requirements pass (no 500, no deadlock, no dupes, correct tenant isolation, unique reference codes, coherent last-write-wins). 2 latency thresholds exceeded (create avg 3.6s vs 2s target, read p95 2.6s vs 1.5s target) — attributed to preview infra + fire-and-forget geocoding on create. Full cleanup done (25 props + 15 clients + 4 agents deleted).

minor.issue: avg latency 3.6s under 25-way parallel load (target <2s). Likely due to fire-and-forget geocoding scheduler + preview infra. No functional errors.
p95 latency 2.6s under 50 concurrent (baseline 42ms). Read amplification ratio 37x — acceptable in preview but should benchmark on prod infra.
